packagePolicy.composer: php-ffmpeg/php-ffmpeg follows upstream Git tags; composer.json does not pin a separate version
packagePolicy.compatibility: V1 accepts only optional non-semantic extensions; incompatible record, derivation, or required-field changes require a new profile/schema and migration notes

keyProviderReview.requiredGate: authenticate the caller and authorize access to the specific video asset before returning its key
keyProviderReview.keyScope: one stable keyId and master key per video asset; no periodic rotation in this release
keyProviderReview.diagnostics: never log or return key bytes, authorization tokens, or provider secrets
evidence: CtrHmacV1Test secret scanning and KeyMaterial redaction assertions

php80HlsMinimumDependencies.runtime: PHP 8.0.30 Docker; isolated dependency resolution constrained to PHP 8.0.30 and prefer-lowest

regression.workerInteroperability: 27 encrypted segments passed PHP-to-Worker clear SHA-256 checks

knownBoundaries: Final release commit/tag is created after the dirty worktree is reviewed and merged.
Production CDN behavior has not been accepted; the maintainer selected the local Docker Nginx proxy as the reproducible acceptance endpoint.
Physical Safari/iOS and Android acceptance is deferred until after launch and remains unverified.
Application-specific entitlement implementation and production KeyProvider are not part of this library acceptance.
The custom CTR/HMAC profile requires the packaged compatible player and is not standard HLS encryption or DRM.
